events.title: Scarcity, from the start
events.description: 20 tracks. 12 resources. Every commitment has an opportunity cost.

events.title: Evidence before action
events.description: Initial observation window complete. Capacity follows consequence-weighted evidence.

events.title: Intent comes into focus
events.description: Repeated observations sharpen destination estimates. Eight possibilities remain visible.

events.title: An apparent risk changes course
events.description: T11 turns toward open water. A lower consequence estimate is not a safety guarantee.

events.title: A turn is not a conclusion
events.description: T03 briefly deviates. Hysteresis gives the estimate time to settle.

events.title: Persistence makes release explainable
events.description: Inspect T11’s evidence and audit trail. Release requires every confidence and persistence gate.

events.title: A quiet track becomes relevant
events.description: T17 changes course near the airport sector. Fresh observations drive reassessment.

events.title: Competing demands emerge
events.description: T18 and T19 change heading. Scarce resources follow sustained priority advantage.

events.title: Compare the decisions
events.description: Review exposure against first-come allocation. Both policies saw the same observations.
